name: ravenforge-glb-web-check
description: Checks an exported GLB: Khronos validator, two browser viewers, finish switching, emulated load timing, and size-reduced copies.

scripts.optimize:compat: gltf-transform optimize --compress quantize --texture-compress webp --texture-size 1024 --simplify false --palette false --instance false --join false --flatten false
scripts.optimize:small: gltf-transform optimize --compress meshopt --texture-compress webp --texture-size 1024 --simplify false --palette false --instance false --join false --flatten false
scripts.optimize:small-joined: gltf-transform optimize --compress meshopt --texture-compress webp --texture-size 1024 --simplify false --palette false --instance false --join true
